import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] f = new long[18];

    static int evaluate(long x) {
        int answer, count = 15;
        if (x <= 11L) return Math.min((int) x, 13 - (int) x);
        while (f[count] >= x) --count;
        answer = (int) ((x / f[count]) * count + evaluate(x % f[count]));
        if ((x << 1) < f[count + 1]) return answer;
        return Math.min(answer, count + evaluate(f[count + 1] - x) + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        f[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= 16; ++i) {
            f[i] = f[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(evaluate(n));
        sc.close();
    }
}
